CB28-009.name: The RowdyDinosaur Anguirus (1972)
CB28-009.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Red Core][Green Core])]
[During Set] (Either Attack Step)
Including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Baby Godzilla", you can pay two costs to summon this Mirage. When you've done so, you can [Contract Advent] a Red "Godzilla" from your Hand, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
When summoned via an effect, your counters +2, and destroy an opposing Nexus; When destroys, draw two cards.

CB28-CX01.name: Baby Godzilla
CB28-CX01.effect:
[CArule]

[Soul State] [Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2]
All the Red symbols on your Field are also treated as Green. Also, while you have ten counters or more, all your Spirits gain an extra Red symbol.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, if you have eight counters or more, during this battle, this Spirit's "BP Destruction effects" can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Heavy Armor]. After this effect resolves, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

CB28-CX03.name: Destoroyah
CB28-CX03.effect:
You can't [Contract Advent] onto this card/Spirit.

[Soul State]
When this Spirit enters Soul State, you can reveal three cards from your decktop. Return the revealed cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each of your symbols, you can reveal a card from your decktop (Max. 5). Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to (the total number of symbols among the "Destoroyah" revealed). Return the revealed cards to the deckbottom.

CB28-CX04.effect:
[CArule]

[Soul State] [Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2]
Once per turn, when opposing Spirits/Ultimates are returned to the Hand/Deck, you can put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, if you have 6 counters or more, during this battle, opposing cards to be returned to the Hand via this Spirit's effect are returned to the deckbottom instead. After this effect resolves, you can return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[Soul State] [Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your "Ghidorah" refreshes via an effect, you can send up to three cores, besides [Soul Core], from your Trash to any of your "Ghidorah".

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, if this Spirit isn't braved, and you have five counters or more, this Spirit can, once per turn, be refreshed; If you have ten counters or more, this Spirit can, once per turn, be refreshed.
